verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents an official RudderStack MCP server at /docs/ai-features/rudderstack-mcp/. It works with any MCP-compatible client (Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot) and exposes concrete capabilities: debugging delivery errors, writing and testing transformations, reviewing tracking plans, detecting duplicate events, and reviewing audit logs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in use.
